jobs.occupation: Project Scientist (m/f/d) (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the fields of solar physics and planetary research, with approximately 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus lies in the investigation of the development, diversity, and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun, and solar-like stars. MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g., ESA, NASA) and conducts cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

For the development of a plasma spectrometer to be flown on the ESA M7-Mission "Plasma Observatory" PMO, the institute is looking for a

Project Scientist (m/f/d)

This position is subject to financing that has not yet been confirmed. As a project scientist you will work as part of an international team on the definition and development of a scientific space instrument in close contact with the project team and external partners at home and abroad.

Your Tasks

- Scientific project lead and contact person to ESA
- Contribute to plasma spectrometer design
- Modelling of plasma spectrometer performance
- Supervision of plasma spectrometer calibration
- Analyse, display, and interpret plasma spectrometer data from previous multi-spacecraft missions in the Earth Magnetosphere – relevant for PMO science
- Perform and interpret MHD and hybrid simulation runs at the boundaries of the Earth magnetosphere specifically designed for the trajectories of the seven PMO spacecraft
- Develop and implement data analysis tools for plasma spectrometer data
- Present scientific results at international conferences, team meetings, project-related meetings, and publish in refereed journals

Your Qualification

- University degree (PhD) in physics or space engineering
- Knowledge in plasma measurement techniques
- Strong understanding of relevant physical concepts and state-of-the-art space/plasma instrumentation
- Knowledge of common programming tools (Python, etc.)
- Knowledge of ion optics simulation tools
- Strong skills in management and organisation
- Ability to work in a structured manner and to document the work
- Willingness to travel internationally
- Good knowledge of English

You should have

• High motivation, problem solving attitude, be a continuous learner, and       team player
• Background knowledge in geophysics, plasma physics or astrophysics
• Experience in experimental physics
• Experience in managing smaller projects
• Experience in space projects (ESA, NASA, etc.) is of advantage

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Remuneration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good public transport connection
- Corporate health management

Additional Information

- The full-time position can be filled starting 4 Jan 2027 or later. Employment is initially limited in time until end of 2030 with a possible extension if the project will be continued and if funding will be available
- The position is rated in acccordance to public service act (TVöD-Bund) as 13
- Temporary teleworking can be negotiated
- Social security benefits are in accordance with the public service regulations.
- End date for application is 30 October 2026

As a scientific institution, the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research offers an attractive international and sophisticated environment with the possibility of implementing one's own ideas and concepts. Moreover, we offer opportunities to reconcile work and family as well as health promotion.

We look forward to receiving your informative application documents (cover letter, CV, references, certificates). Please submit these via the digital application portal (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs) ). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Dr. Norbert Krupp (krupp@mps.mpg.de (krupp@mps.mpg.de) ).

Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

We are currently looking for a Logistics Cost Analyst (d/f/m) to join our team in Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel.

We are a diverse, highly collaborative team of supply chain and logistics experts driving operational excellence and cost efficiency across European central and regional distribution centers in the aerospace spare parts aftermarket. As our regional organisation evolves, you will work closely alongside team leads and operational specialists across international sites to steer financial performance and support strategic decision-making.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary:

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/ paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM

- You will deploy a high-precision financial monitoring system across all European locations to deliver complete spend transparency.
- You will lead the annual operational planning process, monitor actuals against plans, run root-cause analyses for deviations, and manage global financial risks and opportunities.
- You will oversee purchase order execution for business services, consumables, facility operations, and equipment while ensuring budget compliance.
- You will benchmark and analyze supplier contracts for outsourced warehouse operations, initiate cost reduction initiatives, and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, goods receipts, and invoices.
- You will contribute to the global logistics transformation roadmap by building project business cases, unit cost models, and make-or-buy analyses.
- You will design and roll out financial key performance indicators (KPIs) that empower operational teams to boost cost efficiency.
- You will develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships across different departments, sites, and service providers in an international environment.

ABOUT YOU

Equipped with a degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related discipline, paired with professional experience in logistics cost controlling or contract logistics, we are looking for a team player with the following experience, skills and mindset:

- You hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
- You bring solid professional experience in supply chain financial steering and contract logistics.
- You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data analytics tools.
- You show proven ability to build collaborative business relationships and communicate effectively across international teams.
- You feature a structured, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset combined with strong organizational capabilities.
- You possess business fluency in both German and English.

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.
